# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 41 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_041_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 41

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has something in his hand will be given more, and whoever has nothing, even the little he has will be taken from him."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- The Coptic idiom: "has in hand" = has possession of; the accumulation of what one possesses
- cf. Matt 13:12; 25:29; Mark 4:25; Luke 8:18; 19:26 — the "to him who has" saying; widely distributed
- This is one of the most-attested Jesus sayings across the tradition
- In Thomas: no parable context (Matthew's Talents/Minas); the saying stands alone
- "Even the little he has" — the possessionless loses the minimal

---
